title: Ring laws from homogeneous conormal representatives
statement: For conormal presentations A,A′ of closed immersions [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], ambient affine opens U,U′, a ring homomorphism φ:O(U′)→O(U), and an additive map F:A′(i′⁻¹U′)→A(i⁻¹U), suppose every homogeneous ideal-power representative a is mapped to a homogeneous representative b with inclusion(b)=φ(inclusion(a)). Then F preserves one and multiplication.

proof.text: The degree-zero class of one is one by the constants formula. Its image representative has inclusion one, so its class is one as well.

For two homogeneous classes, lift the product of their included ideal-power sections to the corresponding power module using affine ideal sections. The representative formula and multiplication fields of the two presentations show F preserves their product. Extend additively in both variables by affine homogeneous induction.

theorem homogeneous_preserves_ringOperations {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (A : Presentation i) (A' : Presentation i') (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens)
    (φ : Γ(X', U'.1) →+* Γ(X, U.1))
    (F : A'.algebra.right.obj.obj (op (i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1)) →+
      A.algebra.right.obj.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))
    (hF : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : (power i' n).val.obj (op U'.1)),
      ∃ b : (power i n).val.obj (op U.1),
        (powerInclusion i n).app U.1 b = φ ((powerInclusion i' n).app U'.1 a) ∧
        F (homogeneousClass i' A'.algebra A'.inclusion n U'.1 a) =
          homogeneousClass i A.algebra A.inclusion n U.1 b) :
    F 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ a b, F (a * b) = F a * F b
